Jul 14, 2025

The eyes are often the first place we show signs of aging, and the first feature people notice. If you’re dealing with drooping eyelids, puffy under-eye bags, or an overall tired appearance, eyelid surgery (blepharoplasty) could offer the natural-looking refresh you’ve been searching for.

At AestheticEye, our fellowship-trained, board-certified oculoplastic surgeons — Dr. Ginger Henson and Dr. Jonathan Pargament — specialize in cosmetic and functional eyelid surgery in Cincinnati, Springboro, and the greater Dayton, Ohio area. With years of focused experience and a deep understanding of eyelid and facial anatomy, they deliver subtle, confident results tailored to your needs.

Blepharoplasty is not only popular — it’s one of the most effective and highest-rated facial procedures. According to the American Society of Plastic Surgeons, more than 115,000 blepharoplasty procedures were performed in 2023, making it one of the top five cosmetic surgeries in the country.

Here are six signs it may be time to consider eyelid surgery:

1. Sagging Eyelids Are Impacting Your Vision

When upper eyelids begin to hang over the lash line, it’s more than just a cosmetic concern — it could be functional ptosis, a condition that can limit your field of vision. If you find yourself tilting your head back or raising your eyebrows to see clearly, eyelid surgery may be medically necessary, and insurance might cover part of the procedure. Studies show that patients with ptosis can regain up to 50% of their visual field after surgery.

2. You Look Tired — Even When You’re Not

Persistent puffiness, dark circles, or sagging skin around the eyes can create a fatigued or worn-out appearance. A lower or upper blepharoplasty can smooth and refresh the eye area, helping you look more alert and energized while still looking like yourself.

3. Eye Makeup Disappears or Smudges Easily

If drooping upper eyelid skin hides or distorts your makeup, eyelid surgery can restore space on the upper lid and enhance your natural contours. This not only improves the application of cosmetics but also helps define your eyes and restore youthful balance.

4. People Keep Asking If You’re Upset or Tired

Friends or coworkers asking if you’re okay — even when you feel great — is a common complaint we hear from new patients. Eyelid sagging can alter your resting facial expression, making you appear sad, tired, or even angry. Eyelid surgery can help realign your outer appearance with how you actually feel.

5. Daily Activities Like Reading or Driving Are Becoming Challenging

Significant eyelid drooping can interfere with day-to-day tasks like reading, working on a computer, or driving. Many patients subconsciously lift their brows to compensate, which often leads to forehead tension and neck strain. Blepharoplasty offers both cosmetic and functional relief in these cases.

6. You Want a Long-Lasting, Natural Result — Not a “Surgical” Look

At AestheticEye, we believe in enhancing your features without changing your identity. Dr. Henson and Dr. Pargament use advanced oculoplastic techniques to deliver precise, natural-looking results. As fellowship-trained oculofacial surgeons, they understand the delicate structures of the eyelids and face — ensuring safety, symmetry, and subtlety.

In fact, over 92% of patients who undergo blepharoplasty report high satisfaction and say they would choose the procedure again (RealSelf.com).

What to Expect from Eyelid Surgery in Cincinnati or Dayton

Eyelid surgery is typically performed in-office or as an outpatient procedure under local anesthesia or light sedation. Most patients return to their usual activities within 7 to 10 days, with full results becoming visible as swelling subsides over a few weeks. For many, the improvements last for five to ten years or longer.

Meet Your Surgeons: Experts in Eyelid Rejuvenation

Dr. Ginger Henson and Dr. Jonathan Pargament are board-certified by the American Board of Ophthalmology and completed rigorous fellowship training in oculofacial plastic and reconstructive surgery. They are nationally recognized for their advanced techniques, compassionate care, and commitment to patient-centered outcomes. Patients throughout Dayton, Mason, West Chester, and Springboro trust AestheticEye for precision eyelid and facial surgery.

Ready to See the Difference?

If you’re starting to notice the signs listed above — or if loved ones have mentioned your eyes look tired or heavy — it might be time to schedule a consultation. Our team offers personalized eyelid surgery evaluations at our Springboro and Cincinnati locations to help you decide if blepharoplasty is right for you.
